title: Sovereign Tech Fund
description: The Sovereign Tech Agency's fund invests globally in open digital base technologies: libraries, package managers, open protocol implementations, developer tools, encryption and similar infrastructure. It pays for development and maintenance work costing more than EUR 50,000. User-facing applications and prototypes are not funded.
reward: Financing for development and maintenance work; the cost of the work applied for must exceed EUR 50,000 (no maximum is stated)

eligibility.note: an open digital base technology that other software depends on; prototypes are not financed
code under an OSI-approved or FSF Free/Libre license
work costing over EUR 50,000 on base technology, not a user-facing app

setup: make an account on the application platform and turn on its notification emails
each_time: a work plan with hours, months and a EUR cost
rules: Applications are accepted only through the online application platform, in German or English. No deadline is stated.
The work must develop or maintain open digital base technologies. Development is the main focus; security audits and community events can be included when necessary.
The cost of the work described must exceed EUR 50,000.
Not eligible if other public entities already fund the same proposed activities.
All code and documentation must be freely reusable, changeable and redistributable: OSI-approved or FSF Free/Libre licenses for code; no non-commercial or no-derivative clauses for documentation.
Prototypes are not financed, and user-facing applications such as messaging apps or file storage are currently not sought.
Reviewed on prevalence, relevance, vulnerability, public interest, planned activities and expertise. Expect an answer within 10 weeks; about 6 months from application to a potential contract start.
